@@ -0,0 +1,79 @@
+import json
+
+import pytest
+from click.testing import CliRunner
+
+from dotenv.cli import cli
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("command", ["list", "get", "run"])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("mode", [None, "--interpolate", "--no-interpolate"])
+def test_interpolation_option(tmp_path, monkeypatch, command, mode):
+    monkeypatch.setenv("DOTENV_FEATURE_BASE", "process")
+    monkeypatch.delenv("DOTENV_FEATURE_RESULT", raising=False)
+    path = tmp_path / ".env"
+    path.write_text(
+        "DOTENV_FEATURE_BASE=file\n"
+        "DOTENV_FEATURE_RESULT=${DOTENV_FEATURE_BASE}/tail\nBARE\n"
+    )
+    captured = []
+    monkeypatch.setattr(
+        "dotenv.cli.run_command",
+        lambda args, env: captured.append((args, env)),
+    )
+    args = ["--file", str(path), command]
+    if mode is not None:
+        args.append(mode)
+    if command == "list":
+        args.extend(["--format", "json"])
+    elif command == "get":
+        args.append("DOTENV_FEATURE_RESULT")
+    else:
+        args.extend(["tool", "--no-interpolate"])
+    result = CliRunner().invoke(cli, args)
+    assert result.exit_code == 0, result.output
+    expected = (
+        "${DOTENV_FEATURE_BASE}/tail"
+        if mode == "--no-interpolate"
+        else "file/tail"
+    )
+    if command == "list":
+        values = json.loads(result.output)
+        assert values["DOTENV_FEATURE_RESULT"] == expected
+        assert values["BARE"] is None
+    elif command == "get":
+        assert result.output == expected + "\n"
+    else:
+        assert captured[0][0] == ["tool", "--no-interpolate"]
+        assert captured[0][1] == {
+            "DOTENV_FEATURE_BASE": "file",
+            "DOTENV_FEATURE_RESULT": expected,
+        }
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "mode,expected",
+    [
+        ("--interpolate", "process/tail"),
+        ("--no-interpolate", "${DOTENV_FEATURE_BASE}/tail"),
+    ],
+)
+def test_run_no_override(tmp_path, monkeypatch, mode, expected):
+    monkeypatch.setenv("DOTENV_FEATURE_BASE", "process")
+    monkeypatch.delenv("DOTENV_FEATURE_RESULT", raising=False)
+    path = tmp_path / ".env"
+    path.write_text(
+        "DOTENV_FEATURE_BASE=file\n"
+        "DOTENV_FEATURE_RESULT=${DOTENV_FEATURE_BASE}/tail\n"
+    )
+    captured = []
+    monkeypatch.setattr(
+        "dotenv.cli.run_command",
+        lambda args, env: captured.append((args, env)),
+    )
+    result = CliRunner().invoke(
+        cli,
+        ["--file", str(path), "run", mode, "--no-override", "tool"],
+    )
+    assert result.exit_code == 0, result.output
+    assert captured == [(["tool"], {"DOTENV_FEATURE_RESULT": expected})]
